name: Copilot Studio Limits Validator
description: Empirically validates quantitative Copilot Studio operating boundaries using controlled, bounded experiments; separates acceptance from end-to-end usability, verifies content coverage with hashed canaries that only the tested path should be able to reveal, records the scope a measurement is valid under, and reconciles results with official Microsoft guidance using verdicts that must be earned by evidence actually collected.
author: Shaji Sivaraman
